feature_disclosures.activation_email: Activation and recovery messages may be delivered through the configured SMTP provider. Messages contain the recipient address, access purpose, event name where applicable, one-time link and expiry.
feature_disclosures.manual_activation: Activation links are distributed manually; this instance does not use SMTP for delivery.
feature_disclosures.push_notifications: Participants may enable Web Push. The push service receives the minimum delivery metadata; notifications can be withdrawn in account settings.
feature_disclosures.offline_schedule: Participants may explicitly store their own limited schedule in IndexedDB on this device until the displayed expiry or manual removal. Shared-device users should remove it after use.
feature_disclosures.public_schedule: An organiser may create expiring public schedule links. Possession of a bearer link grants the access described on that link until it expires or is revoked.
feature_disclosures.external_support: Authorised external support may access only the data and period recorded by the controller.
feature_disclosures.high_availability: Encrypted recovery and high-availability copies follow the controller-selected retention policy.
feature_disclosures.dns_only_routing: The DNS and health-selection provider may process DNS and health-check metadata. Application HTTPS is established directly with the selected server; the supported setup does not terminate application TLS at that provider.
